cargo_audit.detail: 4 quick-xml advisories (RUSTSEC-2026-0194/0195 on 0.30.0 and 0.39.3) are absent from the x86_64-pc-windows-msvc dependency graph (verified with cargo tree -i on the default target AND --target all: 0.30.0 is a build-dependency of the X11-only xcb crate; 0.39.3 comes via plist/tauri-codegen/wayland-scanner proc-macro + macOS/Linux paths). 16 warning-class advisories are unmaintained/unsound warnings in Linux-only GUI stacks (gtk*/atk*/glib), build-time proc-macros (proc-macro-error*), or non-receipt runtime stacks (rustls-pemfile via reqwest HTTP client, fxhash via screenshots, instant via tao/wry). None of them is in the receipt/readback runtime.
